title: Small Offering
content:
Intro: [1] [4] [1] [5] [4]
Verse 1: 
[1] We stand be[4]fore the [1]King, just to bring an [5]offe[4]ring
for Your [1]love Your Power Your [4]Majes[1]ty Yes we [5]bring, a small [4]offer[1]ing
Intro: 
Verse 2: 
[1] We bow be[4]fore You [1]Lord, for it's You our [5]hearts a[4]dore
for Your [1]love Your Power Your [4]Majes[1]ty Yes we [5]bring, a small [4]offer[1]ing

Chorus 1: 
[5] So we dance and sing Your praise, clap our hands and shout your name 
Raise our hands in the holy place as we sing, holy is Your Name
Yes we bring, a small offering

Verse 1: 
Verse 2: 

Bridge 1: 
These chains that once bound me my Savior, has set me free
Chorus 1:
